definitions.explanation: A person who is currently married.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{既婚者|きこんしゃ}です。
このアンケートは{既婚者|きこんしゃ}が{対象|たいしょう}です。
{既婚者|きこんしゃ}と{独身者|どくしんしゃ}では、{生活|せいかつ}スタイルが{大|おお}きく{違|ちが}うことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Married people and single people often have very different lifestyles.

notes:
{既婚者|きこんしゃ} is a somewhat formal way to refer to someone who is married.

WORD FORMATION:
{既婚|きこん} (already married) + {者|しゃ} (person)

OPPOSITE:
- {未婚者|みこんしゃ}: unmarried person
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}: single person

RELATED:
- {既婚|きこん}: married (adjective-no)
- {結婚|けっこん}している: to be married (more casual way to express the same idea)
